territories.name: Cambodia
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Cambodia levies a value added tax of its own, under the Law on Taxation of 16 May 2023 and Sub-Decree No. 49 ANKr.BK of 11 March 2024 on the Value Added Tax: article 30(2) of the sub-decree reads the rate as 10 per cent, article 29(1) keeps sales at 0 per cent and exempt supplies apart in the records, and the General Department of Taxation sets the due dates of the monthly return.
